idea: Mortgage Delinquency Google Trends Spike Signals Housing Stress Rotation

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'mortgage forbearance' and 'late mortgage payment' through google_trends adapter

behavior: Spikes in mortgage-related distress searches often precede housing market weakness and financial sector credit stress, indicating consumer payment difficulty.

market_impact.rationale: Financial sector credit quality deteriorates when housing distress spreads; mortgage-backed securities and bank loan portfolios face pressure.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Google Trends index for mortgage delinquency searches rises 40% or more from prior week, enter short position
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or if search volume returns to baseline (prior 4-week median)

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Housing stress and payment anxiety searches spike during economic downturns and rate hikes; historically fires 2-3 times per quarter.

idea: Used Car Price Rally Google Trends Signals Discretionary Demand Rebound

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for 'used car prices' and 'cheap used cars near me' through google_trends adapter

behavior: Sustained increases in used car searches correlate with consumers shifting away from new vehicle purchases but maintaining mobility demand, indicating stabilizing affordability perception.

market_impact.rationale: Used car demand strength signals consumer willingness to spend on discretionary purchases and vehicle maintenance; supports consumer cyclical rotation.

trade_logic.entry: If 3-week rolling average of 'used car prices' Google Trends index exceeds prior 8-week median by 25%, enter long position
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 12 trading days or if index falls below 8-week median

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Used car search interest fluctuates weekly with inventory and price changes; high volatility ensures multiple fire events per quarter.

idea: Truck Driver Job Posting Surge Signals Freight Recovery

data.source: RSS feed count spike for 'truck driver jobs hiring' from job boards and news aggregators through rss_count adapter

behavior: Sudden increases in truck driver job postings often coincide with seasonal shipping surges and freight demand acceleration, preceding freight index improvements.

market_impact.rationale: Freight sector hiring signals near-term shipping volume pickup and industrial transportation demand; benefits logistics and industrial equipment manufacturers.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly RSS count for 'truck driver jobs' increases by 50% or more versus prior week, enter long position
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or if RSS count returns to prior 4-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Job posting volume is highly sensitive to seasonal shipping patterns and unexpected demand surges; fires 1-2 times per week on average.

idea: Port Congestion News Spike Signals Logistics Headwind Reversal Trade

data.source: RSS news feed count for 'port congestion' and 'container backlog' from shipping and logistics news through rss_count adapter

behavior: Spikes in port congestion news often precede rapid clearance periods as supply chains self-correct, creating short-duration bullish trades in logistics and transport sectors.

market_impact.rationale: Port congestion news peaks often mark inflection points where volumes clear; transport operators and industrial suppliers see demand recovery.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly RSS count for port congestion news exceeds prior 8-week average by 60% and prior week count was 30% higher, enter long position
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or if RSS count falls below 8-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Port news cycles are volatile and weather-dependent; seasonal shipping peaks and disruptions trigger signal fires 2-3 times per quarter.

idea: EV Charger Installation Acceleration Signals Clean Energy Capex Surge

data.source: OpenChargeMap weekly charger count growth across North America through openchargemap adapter

behavior: Sustained acceleration in EV charger installation rates signal government stimulus pull-through and infrastructure investment acceleration, which precedes utility and energy transition index gains.

market_impact.rationale: Rapid EV charger deployment signals grid modernization spending and utility sector infrastructure capex cycles; benefits power generation and grid operators.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly EV charger count increase exceeds prior 6-week median by 35%, enter long position
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or if weekly growth rate falls below 6-week median

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Charger installation is lumpy and grant-driven; acceleration waves appear 2-3 times quarterly as funding tranches deploy.

idea: Earthquake Aftershock Cluster Google Trends Surge Signals Utility and Insurance Sector Stress

data.source: USGS earthquake activity feed and correlating Google Trends searches for 'earthquake insurance' and 'home damage assessment' through earthquake_activity and google_trends adapters

behavior: Clusters of significant earthquake activity (magnitude 4.0+) followed by spikes in insurance and home damage searches often drive insurance claim expectations and utility infrastructure repair cycles.

market_impact.rationale: Earthquake clusters increase insurance company claims exposure and property damage reserves; property and casualty insurers see margin pressure.

trade_logic.entry: If USGS reports 3+ earthquakes magnitude 4.0+ within 7 days AND Google Trends 'earthquake insurance' search index spikes 50% above prior week, enter short position
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 12 trading days or if seismic activity ceases for 5 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Earthquake clusters occur seasonally in active zones; insurance searches spike consistently after swarms, particularly on US West Coast.

idea: Fed Fund Rate Volatility Expansion Signals Bond Market Repricing

data.source: FRED effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) daily close and 20-day realized volatility through fred_series adapter

behavior: Rapid expansions in Fed funds rate volatility (realized vol spike) often precede sharp bond yield moves and flight-to-safety rotations in equity markets.

market_impact.rationale: Fed rate volatility increases cost of capital and disrupts borrowing conditions; discretionary sectors face compression as duration risk reprices sharply.

trade_logic.entry: If 20-day realized volatility of FEDFUNDS rises 30% above prior 60-day median, enter short position in XLY
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 6 trading days or if volatility returns to 60-day median

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Fed funds volatility spikes frequently during policy uncertainty and inflation data releases; fires 1-2 times per week consistently.

idea: Utility Sector Relative Strength Reversal After Volatility Crush

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for XLU, XLY, and SPY through price_only adapter; compute 30-day realized volatility

behavior: When XLU volatility compresses sharply below its 90-day median while underperforming broad market, defensive rotation often triggers mean-reversion buying in utilities as risk appetite stabilizes.

market_impact.rationale: Utility sectors are defensive hedges; after volatility crush cycles, utilities often outperform as investors rebuild hedges and reduce equity risk.

trade_logic.entry: If 20-day realized volatility of XLU falls 25% below 90-day median AND XLU underperforms SPY by 2% over 5 trading days, enter long position
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or if XLU volatility re-expands above 90-day median

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Volatility cycles in utilities are frequent and driven by interest rate expectations; signal fires 2-3 times per quarter.

market_impact.rationale: Rising healthcare cost concerns drive flight-to-safety; staples sectors benefit as consumers prioritize essential spending and healthcare-linked defensive plays.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Google Trends index for 'health insurance deductible' exceeds prior 8-week median by 45%, enter long position in XLP
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 9 trading days or if search index falls below 8-week median

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Healthcare cost anxiety spikes around open enrollment periods and pharmaceutical price announcements; fires 2-3 times per quarter.

trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or if RSS count falls below 6-week average
